A.disposition: Refine falsifier and explicit extra-control cost; merge existing work
A.mechanism: Assess the inner-selected, sealed feature/parameter/Q/C/prefix recipe through the actual outer-report consumer.
A.prediction: Changing only outer outcomes cannot change the sealed choice, while reversing inner winners must change it; the reported score must match the sealed prefix.
A.nearest_finite_experiment: UNRUN paper/integrated-consumer probe with two arms, two prefix choices and conflicting outer worlds; additional inner-reversal, outer-selecting mutant and pre-seal read-denial controls need separately counted calls.
A.task1_benefit: Avoid treating a vacuous isolated selector or wrong-prefix reporter as validation of automatic-selection assessment.
A.matched_control: Explicit inner-only B2/W1 choice, same identities, outer worlds and report evaluator; an intentionally outer-selecting mutant must fail.
A.negative: Reject implementation evidence on leakage, constant-output selector, reselection or wrong-prefix reporting; a pure function that never receives outer inputs proves only itself.

B.disposition: Accept conditional future one-origin design as research; defer execution
B.mechanism: Fit fixed B/W recipes once each, select own prefixes on mature inner labels, seal then assess once on untouched outer labels without refitting.
B.prediction: The selected recipe may have lower outer utility than the outer-best prefix; the outer-best score cannot replace the selected-prefix score.
B.nearest_finite_experiment: UNRUN two-fit forward-origin design on a separately authorized untouched timeline with concrete dates, source pins and resource reservation still unknown.
B.task1_benefit: Obtain one honest fixed-recipe comparison before contemplating whole-search CV.
B.matched_control: Same Q/C/history/weights/source coverage and predeclared tie rule across fixed B/W arms; both prefixes selected only from inner fullY conditional NDCG.
B.negative: Sparse/undefined outer support or unfavorable contrast is retained; it does not authorize extra folds, refill or final reuse.
